items.prompt: For one remaining row [a,b,c], the top-row step emits it and increments top past bottom. Why guard the later bottom-row step?

options.text: To avoid emitting that same row again in reverse.
options.why: The remaining height is zero; a second pass over the same row would duplicate cells.

options.text: To omit c from the traversal.
options.why: All three cells were correctly emitted by the top-row step. No cell should be removed from output.

options.text: To force a rectangular input to become square.
options.why: The guard tests emptiness after a side emission, not equality of width and height.

options.text: To sort the row before returning it.
options.why: Spiral order is coordinate order and never sorts token values.
